title: Fix the SCIM parity gate's constructor call so it actually prints the seven-model diff against @better-auth/scim 1.7.1
body:
Filed by the triage seat (session `session_01LsWeHbPzR3i6mmonFfGykk`, 2026-08-23) executing the maintainer ruling on #3653 (verbatim: 「10950 不考虑存量，其他接受你的建议」, accepting: fix the parity gate first, rule the migration path on the real diff).

## What

The rc.2/1.7.1 parity gate dies in its collection phase with a TypeError before it can print the seven-model diff it promises (measured on #3653, dev report comment `5386605190`). Fix the constructor call so the gate reaches the diff-printing stage against `@better-auth/scim` **1.7.1** (the stable rewrite: seven new models + conditional managed-connections directory), and attach the produced diff to #3653.

## Scope

Gate repair + one diff run + posting the diff. ⛔ NOT the migration itself — #3653 holds the migration decision and is parked on this card; the maintainer rules the path once the diff exists. Sibling fact card: #11372 (workspace comment undercounts the models — seven + 3 conditional, not six).

## Acceptance

The gate run completes and the seven-model diff (plus managed-connections delta) is posted on #3653.
